reasons.persona_fit: Directly targets 1–10 person business owners in a calm, restrained founder-to-founder tone, adhering strictly to the no-CTA rule and Bareni's workflow-first philosophy.
reasons.clarity: The core thesis is immediately identifiable and unfolds logically with a clear example and unambiguous distinctions.
reasons.actionability: Provides a concrete diagnostic exercise to map an end-to-end workflow and evaluate whether to consolidate, automate targeted steps, or remain manual.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no ungrounded claims, invents no customers or metrics, and stays strictly within approved conceptual boundaries.
